name: El Mirón (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper hoist, crimson below and white above, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Mirón (a castle on green with a bird).
history: Municipal flag of El Mirón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Mirón arms — castle on green with a bird
